comment: Hand-written materials fragment for the building-import example. Instead of cooking a new KTX2 texture (trackg_cook.py textures, which needs ktx.exe), this mod REUSES the stock hangar albedo tile that already ships in the game install: data/tgl/128/a_hangar.ktx2 (+ data/tgl/128/a_hangar.tga). textureName MUST match the texture image name inside the GLB ('a_hangar.png' -> engine derives 'a_hangar.tga'). The 'a_' prefix means alpha-tested and must agree with alphaClass=1 / flags.alpha_test=true (validator rule A6).
